engine_rules.name: Locate Voicing Entry at Cycle × Scale Intersection

then.voicing.scale_context: constrain all voice-leading analysis to the parent scale of the cell

engine_rules.name: Cycle Number Is Root-Motion Interval

engine_rules.anchor: cycles (cycles 2 through 7, representing the interval of motion between successive diatonic chords)

engine_rules.name: Cycle and Scale Are Orthogonal Traversal Axes

then.voicing.cycle_index: cycle axis may be varied independently of scale axis
then.voicing.scale_context: scale axis may be varied independently of cycle axis

engine_rules.name: Close and Spread Are Independent Voice-Leading Objects

engine_rules.anchor: functional voice-leading information

engine_rules.anchor: Most Stepwise Resolution Pattern (M.S.R.P.) strings

engine_rules.name: Prefer the Voice That Carries the Common Tone to Sustain or Minimally Move

then.voicing.cycle_index: hold or minimally displace common-tone voice across cycle step

engine_rules.anchor: intervallic voice-leading relationships, functional voice-leading information

engine_rules.falsifier: Two entries with identical functional profiles that produce non-substitutable results
